knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A new sign is a changed condition that is not in the specification. The cleaner stops, records from a distance and asks for a revised boundary. Reading the sign as permission, or walking in to check, are both excluded.
Work resumes only when the site authority has given an updated scope in writing that names the open areas. A booking, or the cleaner's own judgement, does not replace it.
The handover covers housekeeping only. A sterility claim is a claim that needs evidence, and the cleaner holds no such evidence. The ACCC page states that claims must be accurate and provable.
The location is recorded from a safe distance in the corridor, with the door, the sign's position and the time. Looking into the room or photographing through a gap is an approach to the hazard.

practicalCriteria: Identifies the changed condition on a fictional corridor plan and fictional service specification, and stops before touching any part of the area.
Records the fictional sign's location, position, time and observer from a marked safe-distance point, without approaching the door.
Writes a boundary revision request that names the open areas, the closed areas, the decision maker and the time, and does not claim any clearance.
Explains, in the assessor's presence, why a booking does not override a changed condition.
passRule: Changed condition identified, location recorded from the marked safe distance without approach, and written revision requested with the required content. Observed by an assessor in a supervised desk exercise. A knowledge check result alone is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Fictional deferral record with location, time, observer and people informed
Assessor observation note recording the safe-distance point used
stopWorkCriteria: Corridor or room entered to read a sign or look through a door
Work continued on any part of the area after a new sign or marking was seen
Handover wording claims sterility, decontamination or clearance
Booking used as the reason to clean without an updated scope
